content:
Born as Shalman Barish,

Today, With gratitude, I step into the legal profession as Adv. Shalman Barish

I take one step closer to my dream.
Every class, internship, moot court and challenge has shaped my journey.

This is not the destination—it's the beginning of a lifetime dedicated to justice, integrity and service.

Grateful to my family, mentors and everyone who believed in me.

In Sha Allah, the best is yet to come. ⚖️✨
comment: The transition from law student to advocate is where responsibility truly begins. Beyond legal knowledge, building judgment, ethics and client trust will shape a lasting practice.
